channel.title: Daily Intel Brief
channel.description: Daily AI-generated threat-intel brief: top stories, new KEV entries, early signals and detections.

item.title: Daily Intel Brief: 2026-11-02
item.description: 1. Ivanti patches two more Connect Secure zero-days chained with CVE-2026-104935; CISA adds both to KEV 2. FBI attributes record $6.3 billion Binance crypto theft to North Korea's TraderTraitor 3. Over 1,000 internet-exposed GitLab servers remain unpatched against an actively exploited RCE flaw 4. Chainalysis discloses data breach it attributes to an AI-driven intrusion 5. Apple sends mercenary spyware threat notifications to users in 99 countries 6. Attackers remotely changed refrigeration settings at European supermarket chains 7. Microsoft resolves Smart App Control activation issue caused by October 2026 Windows 11 update 8. WAVLINK WN-series router firmware hit by six remote command injection and overflow CVEs 9. Google disrupts XCPE botnet of over 1.3 million Android TV boxes and bans the device maker 10. Malicious Claude Code extension delivered to Cursor users ran reconnaissance and tried a reverse SSH tunnel Early signals: CVE-2026-105604, CVE-2026-119085, CVE-2026-116606 Explainer: Exploit chaining on edge appliances, and why patching does not evict an attacker Good news: Google and partners dismantle XCPE botnet of more than 1.3 million Android TV boxes Good news: Google offers up to $250,000 for root-in-cloud vulnerability research Good news: SANS ISC explains how to recognise Multipath TCP traffic on your network

item.title: Daily Intel Brief: 2026-11-01
item.description: 1. Brotli decoder buffer overflow CVE-2026-111497 listed by MSRC; KEV-listed with public PoC 2. Northflank breach leads to abuse of customer AI API keys; customers told to rotate all secrets 3. Chainalysis discloses breach exposing customer names, emails, user IDs and roles 4. Cisco Talos details VOLTA infostealer that has an LLM rank victims' stolen assets by monetization value 5. Nine OS command injection CVEs disclosed in WAVLINK routers and access points, no fix stated 6. Critical stack overflow in D-Link DIR-505 TFTP upload handler, exploit reportedly public 7. Public exploit for memory corruption in Horizon DataSys Reboot Restore shield.sys driver 8. Public PoC released for patched Android "SMS of Death" flaw CVE-2026-58882 9. Alpine Linux rebuilds its GitLab server and resets passwords after attempted RCE exploitation 10. Oray Pugongying X5 Pro up to 7.6.1 has two unpatched remote flaws: authorization bypass and path traversal Early signals: CVE-2026-98432, CVE-2026-120308, CVE-2026-120338, CVE-2026-120198, CVE-2026-69836, CVE-2026-112816, CVE-2026-120306, CVE-2026-120307 Explainer: One library flaw, many products: vulnerabilities in embedded dependencies Good news: US court sentences Syrian hacker Ahmad Umar Agha to 42 months in prison Good news: Microsoft Edge picks up a large batch of Chromium security fixes Good news: onedump.py adds JSON output for bulk extraction of files embedded in OneNote Good news: YARA-X 1.22.0 adds built-in 64-bit integer functions for detection rules

item.title: Daily Intel Brief: 2026-10-31
item.description: 1. CISA adds two exploited Ivanti Connect Secure flaws, CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527, to KEV 2. Microsoft: Teams help desk impersonation leads to AD CS ESC1 and ESC8 abuse in two intrusions 3. BeyondTrust Remote Support CVE-2026-102764 allows unauthenticated RCE; listed in KEV, public exploit exists 4. SecurityWeek: PHP2Shell attacks reportedly root Palo Alto firewalls, fail against WordPress 5. CISA reports in-the-wild exploitation of max-severity GitLab RCE CVE-2026-97229 6. Researchers report exploit for critical Linux kernel MPTCP flaw enabling unauthenticated remote root 7. Binance ties roughly $6.3 billion crypto theft to a compromised DevOps engineer laptop 8. Florida Department of Education reports breach of student financial aid site exposing 4.9 million SSNs New KEV entries: CVE-2026-118527, CVE-2026-111357 Early signals: CVE-2026-98432, CVE-2026-112816
